title: Print in Order
constraints: The same Foo instance is passed to three threads.
Threads call first(), second(), third() in random order.
Tested via Python threading — implement the Foo class.

solutionApproaches.title: Semaphore / Event Gates
solutionApproaches.explanation: Use threading.Semaphore or threading.Event so second() waits for first(), and third() waits for second().
